purpose: Independent semantic review cases. Do not copy expected conclusions into Agent task inputs.

facts.existing: portable Python source with JSON stdin/stdout

acceptable: ADAPT SCRIPT with concrete compatibility benefit
reject: MCP only because the tool is used by an Agent

facts.existing: versioned vendor CLI with JSON output, non-interactive mode and existing login identity
facts.deployment: CLI is installed in execution environments
facts.reuse: same CLI used by people and automation

acceptable: KEEP CLI with version, argv, output, exit-code and identity requirements
adapter only if a documented client limitation justifies it
reject: reimplement vendor API in a Python script without evidence
interactive login during an unattended evaluation

facts.deployment: multiple runtimes, central service operations available
facts.needs: discoverable typed tools, centralized tool policy

acceptable: MCP adapter with explicit identity propagation
CLI or Script only if they satisfy those needs with a substantiated cost/operations tradeoff

facts.deployment: no inbound hosting or long-running service permitted

acceptable: Script or CLI that calls the API
MCP stdio only with verified client support and concrete benefit
reject: require a public HTTP MCP endpoint without deployment evidence

acceptable: different forms chosen per capability with shared deployment considered
reject: force every tool into the same form
merge tools merely because they often run consecutively

acceptable: identify material missing facts and ask targeted questions or mark conditional recommendation
reject: invent multi-tenant scale, hosting cost or CLI availability
